item.title: Version 2.2
item.description:
DFP Cleaner 2.2

DFP Cleaner can now update itself. Once a day it checks whether there's a new version. When there is, a window shows what's new, and Install Update downloads it, replaces the app and opens the new one. You can also choose DFP Cleaner > Check for Updates… at any time, or pick Later or Skip This Version.

  • Every update is checked before it's installed. It must carry DF Productions' signature, or it's refused.
  • Nothing about your Mac or your files is sent. The check only fetches the list of versions, and then the update itself.
  • The About box says © 2026 DF Productions, LLC.

This version still comes from Drew. From here on, new versions arrive by themselves.
